g.text: Normalized quadratic h₂ teacher · Initial 1% loss-prefix zoom
Ranks 2, 4, 8, 16 · two reused development seeds per cell · E[Y²] = 1; Var(Y) shown per rank
ReLU student · bounded refit · accepted force clock
SwiGLU student · unrestricted cutoff refit · adaptive flow clock
Bold: two-seed medians on shared support. Bands: seed ranges, not confidence intervals. Faint curves retain individual tails; red markers retain warnings.
Missing arms/diagnostics remain unavailable; no one-seed median or interpolation across missing points. Raw unresolved scores are retained, not certified.
Windows use every recorded loss update; no alignment/refit-based zoom selection. ReLU and SwiGLU clocks, numerical precision and refit classes differ.
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE ONLY — layout and schema checks; no measured rank-sweep outcomes.
